contexts.text: The things which hinder must be removed...
These things are to them as delays and hindrances.
Thus delights... are presented without hindrances...
(Scientifics and pleasures) are the things which hinder...
When the cupidities were removed, so that they did not hinder. Signified, Explained.
To remove such things as hinder celestial love. Signified.
There are two loves... which hinder the influx of celestial love...
Uncircumcised is predicated of that which hinders and defiles...
It is the evil of life which hinders... (Compare AC 2411:end.)
Good... continually inflows into... the man who is cleansed from such things as impede the influx; that is, which reflect, pervert, or suffocate the influent good.
It is only these things which impede the influx of good and truth from the Lord...

That still he could not hinder. Signified. (For) not to grant to do evil, when predicated of the Lord, = not to be able to impede; for no one can do evil to the Divine, but to impede the influx can be done: all evil does this.
Preservation from the evils which hindered conjunction. Signified.
A hindering by resistance. Signified.
That the influx and conjunction are hindered by man's Own loves. References.
Called, the Impediments... of the Impenitent.
Evils are excited by evil Spirits, and are hindered by the Angels.
To every evil there is as it were its own response, that is, hindrance...
As there are no hindrances...
On the hindrances of the communication...
